timelineSteps.summary: Number One attached as authoritative System of Record for Paper Airplane Science Fair Flight Lab
Thinking: Hypothesis: Shifting balance slightly toward the nose and folding 1cm upturned wingtips will keep a dart glider flying straight and past 9 m
Thinking: Trial #1 (Baseline Classic Fold): Flew 5.8 meters, drifted left at 3.2m because wings were uneven.
Dead-end recorded: Taped two pennies near the tail fin hoping it would glide upward (Stalled immediately! Nose pitched up at 1.1m and dropped backward at 1.4m.)
Lesson: Weight belongs near the nose, never the tail
Thinking: Trial #3 (1 Paperclip on Nose): Smooth, straight glide all the way to 9.4 meters!
Lesson: 1cm upturned wingtips stop side-to-side wobble
Decision: Submit the Nose-Balanced Wingtip Dart for Science Fair Finals
